# Option A cost forecast (generated by analysis/cost_model.py)

Path games FT09, SB26, R11L, CD82; held out SP80, VC33, TN36. ARC costs from `results/arc_public_ops/20261001T185155Z/recordings_per_action.csv`. Primary basis: Gemini standard tier, billed estimate from the recordings' cached input; list for reference. OpenAI on Flex with cache writes. Re-run reserve 20% on every counted ARC run.

## ARC (USD; billed / list)

- Block 2 (seed-1 S0+S4, 8 runs): 169.14 / 213.49 without the reserve; 202.97 / 256.19 with it.
- G0 forecast, phase 1b with the reserve (D27 rule 1): 811.86 / 1024.75 against the $900 cap (headroom 88.14 / -124.75).
- Checkpoint C conservative forecast, phase 1b with the reserve: 1042.92 / 1251.80; headroom -142.92 / -351.80 (negative = the 1b cap increase this rule would ask for).
- Held-out runs (18), billed with the reserve: 967.98 with SC at the midpoint, 1381.11 with SC at the Checkpoint C rule.
- G3 (4 runs), billed with the reserve: 101.48 (midpoint), 159.25 (Checkpoint C rule).
- Phase 2 (1k output, billed, SC at the midpoint): 1233.19 with the G3 and held-out reserves, 1054.94 without them, against the proposed $1,150 cap (headroom -83.19).

## What this does not show

- These are forecasts from one published run per game and harness, not measured costs of our configs; S1, S2 and S0+StateCarry have no published run and are priced by rule (midpoint, or the Checkpoint C rule).
- Billed estimates assume our runs cache like the published runs did; our S0 runs on the Interactions API may cache differently.
- StateCarry's own extra calls (promotion, digest) are not priced beyond the rule above; the dev line is the $150 cap, not a forecast.
- PersistGym costs use the PLAN §12 token profile for every task cell; observed and derived episodes are priced the same.
